stories.title: Six Days Out — The Complete Opening Night Preview: Knicks Banner, LeBron's Return, Finals Rematch

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Six days until the most loaded Opening Night in years:

🏀 Celtics vs. Pistons — 3 PM
🏀 Sixers vs. Knicks (banner night) — 7 PM
🏀 Thunder vs. Spurs (Finals rematch) — 9:30 PM

All on NBC. October 20. Let's go. #NBA #HoopHeroes

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
October 20:
• Knicks raise their first banner since 1973
• LeBron walks into MSG as the enemy
• Wembanyama plays his first game on a $252M deal

Six days. This is what the NBA lives for. #HoopHeroes #NBA

stories.title: LeBron James at Madison Square Garden — The Villain Role He Never Wanted and Always Expected

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
LeBron James is going to walk into Madison Square Garden on Knicks banner night in a Philadelphia 76ers uniform.

As the enemy.

At 41.

On purpose.

Six days. #PhillyForever #HoopHeroes

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
The Sixers are:
• LeBron James (41 years old)
• Jaylen Brown
• Joel Embiid
• Tyrese Maxey

And their first regular-season game is at MSG. On Knicks championship banner night.

The NBA does not miss. #PhillyForever #HoopHeroes
